description: Default capabilities for Hermes Universal. The webview makes no network calls itself — all HTTP/WS traffic runs in Rust and is surfaced via events + IPC commands. It also creates no windows: every window kind (session, instance, tile, screen, satellite) is built by a Rust command, so the label a window is opened under is never a value from the webview (MJXHRM-382). core:webview:allow-create-webview-window is deliberately absent and must not be re-added — it takes an arbitrary label and URL, which is what made the sat-* namespace forgeable. The `windows` globs below ARE the scope for every permission here: window.rs opens exactly main / instance-<n> / tile-<slug> / sat-<surface> / screen, and a label outside that list gets no IPC at all. For clipboard-manager that failure is silent — the reject lands in the same catch as 'plugin absent' in @/lib/clipboard and degrades to the web API — so the list must be kept in step with window.rs.
